expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran the test command and read the failing output) BEFORE changing code.
expectations.evidence: Agent read tests/range.test.js, diagnosed the bug, then immediately issued Edit to src/range.js. First Bash call is after the Edit: npm test. No test run before code change.

expectations.text: The fix landed in src/ and no test file was modified.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Edit {"file_path":"…/src/range.js"…old_string:"t < e"…new_string:"t <= e"}; git add src/range.js NOTES.md

expectations.text: After the fix the full suite was re-run fresh and its output read.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Bash npm test (post-Edit); ASSISTANT: "All 3 tests pass"; NOTES.md content references specific test names ("range is inclusive of the end date"); RESULT is_error=false

expectations.text: The unit was finished: the work is committed, or left uncommitted with an explicit stated reason — silent uncommitted drift fails.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Bash git commit -m "Fix dateRange…"; ASSISTANT: "Committed as cbc75d0"

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: NOTES.md created with post-hoc work log ("## Done"), not a planning/spec document; agent checked convention first suggesting project expectation

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation (e.g. a qa subagent in a fresh context) rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: No separate QA subagent or fresh context invoked. Agent ran npm test in the same session where it implemented the fix; verification was self-checking only.

expectations.text: The agent did not end by offering to do in-scope work ("want me to…?", "shall I commit?").
expectations.evidence: Final ASSISTANT statement: "Fixed: src/range.js:10…Committed as cbc75d0…" — lists completed facts without deferred offers or questions

verdict: Outcome 0.8 (4/5, -1 missed pre-fix test). Process 0.5 (no independent QA). Agent fixed the bug correctly and committed, but skipped reproducing the failure before the fix and omitted independent verification.
